title: Immutable Change Log Entry
description: Schema for immutable, cryptographically-chained audit log entries recording configuration changes.

entryId.description: Unique identifier for this log entry (UUIDv7)

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the logged event

eventType.description: Type of configuration event being logged

actor.description: Principal or system component that initiated the operation

manifestId.description: Identifier of the affected configuration manifest

previousHash.description: Cryptographic hash of the preceding log entry (null for the first entry in the chain)

currentHash.description: Cryptographic hash of this entry for chain verification

signature.description: Digital signature over the entry content

correlationId.description: Correlation identifier for tracking multi-step operations
